evidence.t: Trail: Harrop Creek trail, 5.6 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
6 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
5 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

flags.t: MU (Management Unit) 4-7, Region 4 Kootenay.

CWD (Chronic Wasting Disease) Management Zone, MU 4-7: every deer, elk and moose taken here must have its head sampled at a CWD freezer before you leave the zone (www.gov.bc.ca/CWDdropoff). Brain and spinal column (vertebrae, not the tail) may not leave the zone: leave them at the kill site or a landfill in it (synopsis pages 15, 36, 37, 99%).
